Market today: Geopolitical tensions are flaring in the Middle East, driving up oil prices and creating a risk-off mood. This environment is generally tough for growth-oriented tech and chip names, especially with margin amplifying any drops.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.51%) and SPAL (-33.52%) are leveraged, decaying, and show deep losses with stops that appear misaligned. SPY is also flagged as a SELL, while QQQ, SMH, and QQQI are on TRIM status.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further developments in the Middle East and their impact on energy prices. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs closely for further decay.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and re-evaluate your leveraged positions given the current market headwinds.
plays: SOXL is a deep loss, leveraged SELL. Re-evaluate your stop; its decay and margin impact demand attention.
SPAL, another leveraged SELL, also shows a deep loss. Review its stop and consider reducing exposure due to decay and margin risk.
Consider a small hedge with SQQQ (entry 39.74-39.7, stop 39.58) given the market's risk-off tone and your tech concentration.
